# Dragoman SeaKayak

> Dragoman SeaKayak is a guided sea kayaking operator based in Kaş, Antalya, Türkiye.
> We run day tours and multi-day expeditions along the Lycian coast — Kekova's
> Sunken City, Simena Castle, hidden coves and sea caves — with certified guides,
> all equipment and meals included. The site is available in Turkish, English,
> French, Russian and German.

- [Kekova & Kaş sea kayak day tours (TR)](https://dragomanseakayak.com/tr/turlar): Published day tours with routes, durations and prices.

- [Kekova & Kaş sea kayak day tours (DE)](https://dragomanseakayak.com/de/turlar): Published day tours with routes, durations and prices.
- [Custom & private tours (TR)](https://dragomanseakayak.com/tr/ozel-turlar): Tailor-made private kayak tours on request.
- [Custom & private tours (EN)](https://dragomanseakayak.com/en/ozel-turlar): Tailor-made private kayak tours on request.
- [TRAK experience (TR)](https://dragomanseakayak.com/tr/trak-experience): Multi-day expedition format combining kayaking, camping and local culture.
- [TRAK experience (EN)](https://dragomanseakayak.com/en/trak-experience): Multi-day expedition format combining kayaking, camping and local culture.
